item.title: Who is Fred Liu? Evelyn Ha’s ex boyfriend backs Ben Pasternak’s claims and alleges past abuse details
item.description: Fred Liu, Evelyn Ha’s ex-boyfriend, has supported parts of Ben Pasternak’s abuse claims after his arrest in New York. Pasternak denies all charges and says Ha was the aggressor. Liu shared that his past experience felt similar but stayed silent earlier. The case includes serious assault charges and is ongoing, with court proceedings expected on June 11.

item.title: Lewandowski set to leave Barcelona after four years as contract offer falls short of his ambitions
item.description: Robert Lewandowski is set to leave FC Barcelona at the end of the season, with the club offering him a one-year renewal that fails to meet his footballing ambitions. Despite interest from Italy, the United States, and Saudi Arabia, Lewandowski remains focused on continuing in Europe’s top leagues. Barcelona is already eyeing replacements, including Julian Alvarez.
item.dc:creator: TOI Sports Desk

item.title: Counter-Strike legend pashaBiceps donates $21K to Poland Cancer Fighters stream after knife skin sale
item.description: Retired Counter-Strike pro pashaBiceps sold an iconic in-game knife skin for over $21,000, donating the entire sum to a Polish children's cancer charity. The sale of the rare digital item, originally gifted to him years ago, directly benefited the Cancer Fighters foundation, highlighting the positive impact of the esports community when united for a good cause.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: Ben Pasternak breaks silence on Evelyn Ha abuse allegations: Full controversy explained
item.description: Tech entrepreneur Ben Pasternak has denied strangulation and assault charges following his breakup with Evelyn Ha. Pasternak claims he was the victim of abuse throughout their relationship, presenting evidence like medical reports and past partner accounts. The case is heading to court, with a hearing scheduled for June, as both sides prepare to present their versions of events.
item.dc:creator: Sumit Roy

item.title: Wembley shame: Leeds United fans face prosecution after homophobic chanting targeting Chelsea at FA Cup semi-final
item.description: Leeds United’s FA Cup semi-final defeat to Chelsea has been overshadowed by police action against homophobic chanting, with 16 fans reported for prosecution under updated Crown Prosecution Service guidance. Amid a tense, physical match at Wembley, broader concerns around discriminatory abuse, including ongoing “Savile” chants, highlight football’s increasing legal and cultural reckoning with fan behaviour.

item.title: France's darkest royal scandal: When a nation believed poison was everywhere
item.description: A scandal in 17th-century France exposed a hidden network of fortune tellers and alleged poisoners serving the elite. As investigations widened, fear spread rapidly, fuelled by rumours and forced confessions. When accusations reached the royal court, the king shut it down, leaving a story shaped as much by panic and power as by truth.

item.title: Roman Dubowski £1m Win: ex-IT analyst lands Millionaire jackpot; plans house, big trips
item.description: Former IT specialist Roman Dubowski has won a £1m jackpot on Who Wants To Be A Millionaire?, becoming the seventh contestant to achieve the top prize. He correctly answered 15 questions, relying on precision and careful choices, with his final answer linked to Bass Ale's registered symbol.

item.title: “Trust no man”: Yonna makes bold statement as Megan Thee Stallion ends relationship with Klay Thompson over trust
item.description: Streamer Yonna reacted strongly after Megan Thee Stallion confirmed her breakup with Klay Thompson and suggested he had broken her trust. Megan said respect, trust, and loyalty are non-negotiable in a relationship. Yonna agreed and shared her own views about trust in dating. Klay Thompson has not responded to the public breakup claims so far.

item.title: World’s ‘worst’ FIFA football team that lost every match, yet almost qualified for 2026 World Cup
item.description: San Marino’s World Cup story is one of football’s most enduring underdog narratives, defined less by results than by persistence. Ranked 211th and made up largely of part-time players, they continue to face Europe’s elite in every qualifying cycle, absorbing heavy defeats while occasionally producing historic moments. Their journey captures what it means simply to belong in the global game.

item.title: Board game harassment: Japanese firefighter suspended for forcing coworkers to play homemade board games for six months
item.description: A Japanese firefighter sergeant faced suspension for forcing colleagues to play handmade board games during duty hours for six months. What he called team-building was deemed coercive, especially after reports of pressure. The incident, involving falsified logs and a cover-up attempt, highlights workplace power dynamics and blurred boundaries, leading to disciplinary action for multiple personnel.

item.title: 'I am not a rapist': Donald Trump erupts in interview as media dinner shooting fallout deepens
item.description: President Trump angrily denounced a journalist for reading excerpts from a suspect's manifesto during a 60 Minutes interview, forcefully rejecting accusations of sexual assault. The incident occurred after a security scare at a media dinner where a suspect armed with multiple weapons was intercepted by Secret Service agents.
